scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 46 boards of four live Deity Online Culture games of 2026-11-10/11 with 6-12 cities: Pericles 232642Z (19 boards, t66-t176) and 000134Z (8 boards t36-t120, each run twice, the second time with culture-faith-braves-the-barbarians on both arms), Kristina 205256Z (t108, t110, t128) and 173750Z (t61, t88, t106, t116), and four late 232642Z boards (t164-t170) with culture-faith-braves-the-barbarians on both arms; each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 29685a1306 with the run's own requested genome, every version of the family removed and culture-faith-site-per-theater-2 added (232642Z and 000134Z were armed with it live); the on arm adds --with culture-faith-site-per-theater-3. Produce or research orders differ on 17/46. Where version two fills a Theater city's last free slot with a Diplomatic Quarter, Commercial Hub or Industrial Zone, or leaves it to a Monument behind its six-site cap, version three claims the Holy Site (232642Z t66 Athens, t91 Argos, t102 Athens; 205256Z t108 and t110 Strangnas and t128 Uppsala, both past version two's six-site cap; 173750Z t88 Vasteras, t106 Stockholm; 000134Z t89 Argos and t120 Pharsalos with the barbarian rule) or keeps the slot while a hold delays the claim (232642Z t88 Eretria, the war holding the claims; 173750Z t61 Stockholm, a backlog Builder; 000134Z t89 Argos, a Barbarian within six tiles); 000134Z t36 and t40 research Astrology in place of Horseback Riding and Construction.
